subject: Newsletter update - need Technical Corner article
body:
Good Morning, Vince!

After going over our department list, I believe that, with the exception of a part-timer or two, we have covered everybody in the newsletter. If we have recently hired someone who might not be on the list, would you please let me know? Also, if you have a good article from someone that we can use for a Technical Corner, we will need that, too.
